title: Best Apple Deals of the Week: AirTag 2 Hits Record Low Price, Plus Early Black Friday Sales
content:
Black Friday is two weeks away, and this week we saw numerous early discount events pop up online, including great sales at Amazon, Anker, Samsung, Walmart, and more.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Early Black Friday Sales



  • What's the deal? Shop early Black Friday events

  • Where can I get it? Amazon, Walmart, Samsung, and Anker


A number of retailers officially kicked off early Black Friday discount events this week, including Walmart, Samsung, Anker, and Amazon. We've recapped all of the best deals in each of these sales in our dedicated articles, which you can find linked below.

  • Anker: Save on popular Anker charging accessories

  • Amazon: Save on Apple products, TVs, Alexa devices, and more

  • Walmart: Save on TVs, computers, and more

AirTag 2



  • What's the deal? Get all-time low prices on AirTag 2

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$6 OFF
AirTag 2 (1-Pack) for $23.00

$29 OFF
AirTag 2 (4-Pack) for $69.99


One of the best early Black Friday deals has arrived this week, with Apple's AirTag 2 available for $69.99 on Amazon, down from $99.00. This deal is on the 4-Pack of the AirTag 2, and it's a match of the record low price for the accessory.

Apple Watch Ultra 4



  • What's the deal? Get $99 off Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$99 OFF
Apple Watch Ultra 4 for $699.99


The Apple Watch Ultra 4 has dropped to $699.99 on Amazon, down from $799.00. This is a match of the all-time low price on the new Ultra 4, which just launched in September.

Mac Mini and Mac Studio



  • What's the deal? Get record low prices on Mac mini and Mac Studio

  • Where can I get it? Amazon

  • Where can I find the original deal? Right here

$200 OFF
M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,299.00

$120 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $779.00

$150 OFF
M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB for $949.00


Apple's M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and a 512GB SSD is still on sale for $2,299.00, down from $2,499.00. Regarding the Mac mini, you can get the 16GB RAM/256GB SSD Mac mini for $779.00, down from $899.00, and the 16GB RAM/512GB SSD model for $949.00, down from $1,099.00.
